color-contrast-checker.description: Free color contrast checker. Check WCAG AA contrast between two HEX colors for normal and large text. Runs in your browser.
color-contrast-checker.extra: Enter foreground and background HEX colors to see the contrast ratio and WCAG AA results for normal and large text. Good contrast makes text readable for everyone.
faq: What contrast ratio does WCAG AA require?
For normal text, at least 4.5:1. For large text, at least 3:1.
Why does contrast matter?
Good contrast makes text readable for people with low vision or in bright light, and helps meet accessibility guidelines.
